name: donnabot-desktop
description: Mexerica (fork privado do Codync) for macOS and Linux: your coding agents as teammates.

scripts.build:demo: vite build --config vite.demo.config.ts && mv dist/demo/desktop/index.html dist/demo/desktop.html
scripts.test: node --test --experimental-strip-types src/main/*.test.ts src/shared/*.test.ts src/shared/relay-protocol/*.test.ts src/renderer/lib/*.test.ts src/renderer/store/*.test.ts src/renderer/views/thread/*.test.ts src/renderer/views/routines/*.test.ts src/renderer/views/call/*.test.ts src/renderer/views/fork/*/*.test.ts src/main/fork-cloud/*.test.ts src/main/fork-account/*.test.ts src/main/fork-voz/*.test.ts src/main/fork-secret-box/*.test.ts src/main/fork-cofre-seguro/*.test.ts src/main/fork-ssh-semente/*.test.ts src/main/fork-instalacao-remota/*.test.ts src/web/*.test.ts src/web/*/*.test.ts tools/web-dist/*.test.ts
scripts.dist:mac:dev: node tools/account-config.mjs dev && node tools/native-host.mjs dev && node tools/native-screen.mjs dev && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac --config tools/dev-builder.cjs
scripts.dist:mac:local: node tools/account-config.mjs main && node tools/native-speech.mjs && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac --config tools/local-builder.cjs
scripts.dist:mac:dev:client: node tools/account-config.mjs dev && node tools/native-speech.mjs && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac --config tools/dev-local-builder.cjs
scripts.dist:mac:main: node tools/account-config.mjs main && node tools/native-host.mjs main && node tools/native-screen.mjs main && electron-vite build && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:linux:dev: node tools/account-config.mjs dev && electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux --config tools/dev-builder.cjs
scripts.dist:linux:main: node tools/account-config.mjs main && electron-vite build && electron-builder --linux
scripts.dist:win:dev: node tools/account-config.mjs dev && node tools/native-host.mjs dev && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win --config tools/dev-builder.cjs
scripts.dist:win:main: node tools/account-config.mjs main && node tools/native-host.mjs main && electron-vite build && electron-builder --win
